chapters.label: One last corner
chapters.text: The Hawthorns, 2021. Liverpool must win, but it's one-all and time is up. So goalkeeper Alisson runs up for one last corner! Trent Alexander-Arnold swings it in... Alisson heads it! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Alisson finds space at the near post, and nobody follows him. He jumps and flicks it on with his head.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: it flies into the far top corner. The whole team runs to hug him!

chapters.label: Never give up
chapters.text: Never give up! In the last seconds, even the goalkeeper can go up and help the team.
